SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-17-2010 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LILLY, PHD, VELORA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BYRDSONG, REVEREND DEWAYNE PIERSON, DDS, GRAYSON $2,012.00 PRINCIPAL, $461.45 INTEREST, $60.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,533.45, EACH PARTY SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR ONE HALF OF THE JUDGMENT, INTEREST AND COSTS. DEFENDANT DEWAYNE BYRDSONG SHALL BE GIVEN CREDIT FOR HIS RECENT PAYMENT OF $56.00. THEREAFTER, DEFENDANT DEWAYNE BYRDSONG SHALL PAY $150.00 ON OR BEFORE SEPTEMBER 24, 2010; AND THEREFATER IN MONTHLY INSTALLMENTS OF $200.00 COMMENCING ON OR BEFORE OCTOBER 14, 2010, AND ON OR BEFORE THE 14TH OF EACH SUCCEEDING MONTH. IF ANY PAYMENT IS MISSED, THE ENTIRE BALANCE BECOMES DUR IMMEDIATELY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
